title: Aggregate
source_location: ISO 32000-2 EC3 primary PDF, printed pp. 722–741 / physical pp. 737–756 for logical-structure clauses; framing checked against §14.7.1 and specific child clauses. Broad row has no separate implementation rule beyond the children.
errata: EC3 #452 renumbers former §14.7.5.1.1–.4 to effective §14.7.5.2–.5; the 2020 ledger labels remain old numbers. See detailed prior shard `logical_structure/features.json`.
ledger: `doc/conformance/ledger.toml` marks §14.7 implemented, citing structure reading, accessibility projection, and structure writing/reconciliation paths.
tests_assertions: The broad row has no distinct test oracle. Child assertions are separately reviewed in `logical_structure`, `logical_structure_example.rs`, `structure_types`, and `structure_layout_remaining_current`. The example test asserts its mapped Chap/Head1/Para roles, class-vs-element attribute precedence, per-page ParentTree entries, IDTree lookups, cross-page paragraph references, and nonzero-generation reference. Parent current findings confirm B03/B04 for depth/fan-out; do not describe these as pending/unexecuted candidates.
verdict: aggregate claim is directionally supported by child evidence, not independently certified
residuals: B03/B04 are confirmed in the parent current findings: traversal depth and fan-out limits can silently truncate logical structure without setting the public truncation signal. `logical_structure/findings.txt` and `tagged_layout/decisions.json` contain prior evidence/drafts; parent findings/gate results are authoritative. Other untested tree producer constraints and invocation permutations remain bounded residuals.

title: General
source_location: EC3 primary PDF, printed p. 722 / physical p. 737; opening of §14.7.
errata: No change to the general framing identified. Effective child renumbering under #452 is relevant to the cross-reference to marked-content sequences.
ledger: Implemented. The note describes a logical structure independent of, but associated with, content; ledger further states an archive preparation policy for `/MarkInfo /Marked true`.
code: `pdf-model/src/structure.rs` reads an optional `/StructTreeRoot`; `content.rs` retains marked-content association; archive rewrite prepares/tag-reports through `pdf-transform/src/archive/rewrite.rs`.
tests_assertions: Worked-example and MarkInfo tests have their stated mechanism scope. Archive preparation only checks non-null StructTreeRoot before marking. Separate archive checks exist, but the whole tagged-pdf requirement is Check::Unchecked; this is not a general certification guard.
verdict: framing supported; ledger's archive convention is a project policy, not a distinct requirement imposed by this introductory prose
residuals: StructTreeRoot presence does not prove all Tagged PDF conventions. Existing archive positive fixture is a blank page with empty root. No new invalid document or false-positive runtime result is established here.

title: Tagged PDF and page content
source_location: EC3 primary PDF, printed pp. 745–753 / physical pp. 760–768; specific rules split across 14.8.2 children.
errata: The direct marked-content form language in .2.2 is revised by #484; other child errata are recorded in `tagged_layout` and related shards.
ledger: Implemented aggregate of page content, artifact classification, ordering, and Unicode-related child obligations.
code: `content.rs`, `content/marked.rs`, `structure.rs` and `structure/logical.rs`; public copied text and accessibility are separate consumers.
tests_assertions: `tagged_layout/findings.txt` covers valid logical order, Unicode/word boundaries, artifacts and cross-shard ActualText issues. `structure_layout_remaining_current/findings.txt` records B43: public AccessKit emits ACB from valid `/K` interleaving where logical text is ABC.
verdict: child assertions demonstrate distinct behavior; aggregate cannot be called conformant while B43 is unresolved
residuals: No duplicate B43 test. Explicit Artifact marking is not mandatory in the face of #484 and §14.8.2.2.2 expressly makes out-of-tree page/annotation content an artifact even without an Artifact tag.

title: Real content and Artifacts
source_location: EC3 primary PDF, printed pp. 746–747 / physical pp. 761–762; §14.8.2.2.1 and .2.2, Table 363.
errata: EC3 #484 moves the producer statements that the two explicit marked-content forms shall be used into NOTE 2; it does not remove the rule in the next paragraph that content outside the structure tree is an artifact. #483 permits ActualText as an Artifact property-list entry.
ledger: Implemented; reading classifies explicit and by-absence artifact spans.
tests_assertions: `pdf-model/tests/artifact_reporting_audit.rs::artifact_reporting_does_not_remove_text_and_absence_is_separate_from_declaration`, `accessibility.rs::content_no_element_reaches_is_an_artifact_by_absence`, and viewer tagged-copy artifact tests pin declared vs inferred status and text consequences. Parent's current ledger note further records the MarkInfo `/Marked true` qualification and annotation appearance exception.
verdict: supported in tested declared and absence paths
residuals: Artifact filtering is a consumer choice; do not assert every processor must suppress it. Do not invent a producer-invalid unmarked-content classification: §14.8.2.2.2 explicitly says unreferenced page and annotation content is artifact even without an explicit Artifact tag.

title: General (layout attributes)

title: Standard structure namespaces
source_location: EC3 primary PDF, printed pp. 794–795 / physical pp. 809–810; §§14.8.6.1–.3. Primary text specifies both standard namespace URIs and MathML URI.
errata: No namespace URI/default renumbering found. MathML and role-map requirements stay distinct in effective §14.8.6.3 and .2.
ledger: Implemented; outside-standard namespace conditions are reported at document scope, not treated as an unconditional reader rejection.
code: `structure/roles.rs` identifies PDF 1.7/PDF 2.0 namespaces, resolves role maps and reports outside-standard namespaces; `viewer-core/src/notes.rs` delivers document-level report.
tests_assertions: `structure_types/findings.txt` records explicit/default namespace controls, namespace-specific mappings, foreign homonyms, and MathML distinctions. Existing test `an_element_stating_no_namespace_is_in_the_default_standard_one` checks the default PDF 1.7 URI; separate MathML fixture checks URI qualification.
verdict: supported for sampled namespace defaults, role-map resolution, and reporting
residuals: Missing `/NS` means PDF 1.7 namespace, not PDF 2.0. A PDF2 namespace dictionary is separate and must be explicitly identified. Other namespace validity is a producer/reporting question; do not reject or reinterpret unqualified tags as PDF2 by assumption.
